vehicles.name: Freight Trailer
vehicles.description: A long freight trailer pulled by semi trucks on Leonida's highways, returning from earlier games.

vehicles.name: Freight Train
vehicles.description: The Freight Train is a service vehicle with the look of the EMD GP38-2. Returning from past games, it uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Freight Train (tanker car)
vehicles.description: A tanker wagon that runs as part of the freight trains crossing Leonida, returning from earlier games.

vehicles.name: Gallivanter Baller II
vehicles.description: Gallivanter's Baller II is an SUV styled after the Range Rover Evoque/Range Rover Sport. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Gallivanter Baller ST-D
vehicles.description: Gallivanter's Baller ST-D is an SUV styled after the fifth-generation Range Rover (L460). Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: GranForma Zorrusso
vehicles.description: A supercar from GranForma, modelled on the Italdesign Zerouno. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Grotti Bestia GTS
vehicles.description: Grotti's Bestia GTS is a sports car styled after the Ferrari FF. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Grotti Carbonizzare
vehicles.description: Grotti's Carbonizzare is a sports car styled after the Aston Martin V12 Zagato. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Grotti Cheetah ’95
vehicles.description: The Grotti Cheetah '95 is an Ultimate Edition sports classic in GTA 6, a 1990s mid-engined coupe with a listed 4.9L V8.

vehicles.name: Grotti Itali GTO
vehicles.description: The Grotti Itali GTO is a sports car with the look of the Ferrari 812 Superfast. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Grotti Itali RSX
vehicles.description: Grotti's Itali RSX is a sports car styled after the Ferrari SF90 Stradale. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Hauners APC
vehicles.description: Hauners' armoured personnel carrier, one of GTA 6's military vehicles. It comes with a military-grade tracker, so taking one will not go unnoticed.

vehicles.name: Hauners Rhino Tank
vehicles.description: Hauners' Rhino Tank is a military vehicle styled after the M1 Abrams. Back from earlier GTA games, it is a single-seater and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: HVY Airtug
vehicles.description: HVY's Airtug is a 1990s electric utility vehicle styled after the Clark CT30. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses front-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: HVY Bulldozer
vehicles.description: An industrial vehicle from HVY, modelled on the Caterpillar 963D. Returning from past games, it is a single-seater and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: HVY Lifta
vehicles.description: HVY's Lifta is a utility vehicle styled after the Yale Forklift truck model (Yale GLP060VX). Back from earlier GTA games, it is a single-seater and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: HVY Mixer
vehicles.description: The HVY Mixer is an industrial vehicle with the look of the Kenworth T800. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: HVY Ripley
vehicles.description: The HVY Ripley airport tug for moving aircraft and baggage around the apron, back from earlier games and seen in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Imponte DF8-90
vehicles.description: Imponte's DF8-90 is a sedan styled after the Pontiac G6. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Imponte Phoenix '77
vehicles.description: The Imponte Phoenix '77 is a 1970s muscle car with the look of the Chevy Camaro. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Imponte Ruiner '82
vehicles.description: A 1980s muscle car from Imponte, modelled on the Pontiac Trans Am/Chevrolet Camaro. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Impounded Vehicle
vehicles.description: Impounded Vehicle is an optional Chapter 2 job where you break Lucia's car out of the police impound in Port Gellhorn. It starts automatically after Breakfast Run.

vehicles.name: Interstate Ambulance
vehicles.description: The ambulance version of the Declasse Burrito '98, answering medical calls. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Interstate Benson '97
vehicles.description: Interstate's Benson '97 is a 1990s commercial truck styled after the International 4700 Delivery Truck Chassis. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Interstate Stockade '99
vehicles.description: The Interstate Stockade '99 is a 1990s commercial truck with the look of the International 4700 Series. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Interstate Yankee '80
vehicles.description: A restored 1980s Interstate commercial truck in GTA 6. Examples found on the street have no tracker fitted, so taking one draws less heat.

vehicles.name: Invetero Coquette
vehicles.description: A sports car from Invetero, modelled on the Corvette C7. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Invetero Coquette '64
vehicles.description: A 1960s classic sports car from Invetero, modelled on the Chevrolet Corvette C2. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Invetero Coquette D10
vehicles.description: The Invetero Coquette D10 is a sports car with the look of the Chevrolet Corvette C8. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Jacksheepe Fieldmaster '99
vehicles.description: Jacksheepe's Fieldmaster '99 is a 1990s utility vehicle styled after the John Deere 7810. Back from earlier GTA games, it is a single-seater and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Jet
vehicles.description: The Jet is a plane with the look of the Boeing 747-400. Back from earlier GTA games, it carries two people.

vehicles.name: JoBuilt Flatbed
vehicles.description: An industrial vehicle from JoBuilt. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: JoBuilt Phantom
vehicles.description: The JoBuilt Phantom is a commercial truck with the look of the Peterbilt 359 EXHD. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: JoBuilt Phantom Custom '81
vehicles.description: A reworked take on the JoBuilt Phantom, built as a 1980s commercial truck. A series regular, it seats five and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: JoBuilt Rubble
vehicles.description: A vehicle seen in official GTA VI footage.

vehicles.name: Karin Allander
vehicles.description: Karin's Allander is a modern SUV styled after the fifth-generation Toyota RAV4. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Karin Allander Taxi
vehicles.description: The Karin Allander compact SUV in taxi colours, ferrying fares around Leonida. Like the regular Allander, it is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Karin Asterope GZ
vehicles.description: A sedan from Karin, modelled on the Toyota Camry (XV30). Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Karin Contender
vehicles.description: Karin's Contender is an SUV. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Karin Feroci '98
vehicles.description: Karin's Feroci '98 is a 1990s sedan styled after the first-generation Lexus GS 300. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Karin Futo '85
vehicles.description: The Karin Futo '85 is a 1980s sports car with the look of the Toyota AE86 Levin. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Karin Intruder
vehicles.description: A sedan from Karin, modelled on the Infiniti Q45/I30. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Karin Rebel '84
vehicles.description: The Karin Rebel '84 is a 1980s off-roader with the look of the Toyota Hilux. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Karin Vivanite
vehicles.description: An SUV from Karin, modelled on the fourth-generation Toyota Sienna (XL40). Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Lampadati Novak
vehicles.description: An SUV, spotted in Rockstar's screenshots.

vehicles.name: Lapwing Duster 300-H
vehicles.description: A Lapwing light plane listed alongside the classic Duster crop duster. Its stats and how to get it have not been pinned down yet.

vehicles.name: Lapwing Mallard
vehicles.description: Lapwing's Mallard is a plane styled after the Extra EA-300. Back from earlier GTA games, it carries one person.

vehicles.name: Lapwing Mammatus
vehicles.description: A plane from Lapwing, modelled on the Cessna 172 Skyhawk. Returning from past games, it carries four people.

vehicles.name: Lapwing Nimbus
vehicles.description: The Lapwing Nimbus is a plane with the look of the Cessna Citation X. A series regular, it carries eight people.

vehicles.name: LCC Avarus
vehicles.description: The LCC Avarus is a motorbike with the look of the Generica mostly-naked chopper. A series regular, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Lombike
vehicles.description: The Lombike is an electric bicycle with the look of the CitiBike Miami E-Bikes. First appearing in GTA 6, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Lure Predator L20S
vehicles.description: A Lure Predator boat that makes its series debut in GTA 6, joining the maker's L35P on Leonida's coastal waters. Few other details about it are known so far.

vehicles.name: Lure Predator L35P
vehicles.description: Lure Predator's L35P is a boat styled after the Contender 24S. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Lure Predator L35P Police Boat
vehicles.description: The police version of the Lure Predator L35P, a boat used by Leonida law enforcement. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Caddy '82
vehicles.description: A 1980s electric utility vehicle from Maibatsu, modelled on the Club Car Precedent golf cart. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Iota
vehicles.description: The Maibatsu Iota is a commercial truck with the look of the Isuzu Elf 250. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Manchez
vehicles.description: A motorbike from Maibatsu, modelled on the 500cc KTM. Returning from past games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Mule
vehicles.description: A commercial truck from Maibatsu, modelled on the Mitsubishi Fuso Canter (7th gen). Returning from past games, it seats six and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Penumbra
vehicles.description: A sports car from Maibatsu, modelled on the Mitsubishi Eclipse. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Penumbra FF '97
vehicles.description: A 1990s sports car from Maibatsu, modelled on the second-generation Mitsubishi Eclipse. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Maibatsu Sanchez
vehicles.description: A motorbike from Maibatsu, modelled on the 2006-2009 Yamaha YZ450F. Returning from past games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Mammoth Dodo
vehicles.description: A plane from Mammoth, modelled on the De Havilland Canada DHC-2 Beaver. Returning from past games, it carries four people.

vehicles.name: Mammoth Patriot '92
vehicles.description: The Mammoth Patriot '92 is an off-roader with the look of the Hummer H1 SUV. A series regular, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Mammoth Streamer216
vehicles.description: The Mammoth Streamer216 is a plane with the look of the de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter. A series regular, it carries four people.

vehicles.name: Mer-Can Blast
vehicles.description: Mer-Can's Blast is an off-roader styled after the Polaris Ranger. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Mer-Can Outlaw
vehicles.description: The Mer-Can Outlaw is an off-roader with the look of the Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: MTL Dump
vehicles.description: MTL's Dump is a heavy industrial truck in GTA 6's line-up. Its stats, price and where to find one have not been confirmed yet.

vehicles.name: MTL Packer
vehicles.description: MTL's Packer is a commercial truck styled after the 1994 International 9000/9200. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: MTL Pumper
vehicles.description: An emergency vehicle used by firefighters, modelled on the 2012 Pierce Arrow XT rescue pumper. A series regular, it carries eight people and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: MTL Wastelander
vehicles.description: A service vehicle from MTL. Returning from past games, it seats six and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Nagasaki Blazer
vehicles.description: An off-roader from Nagasaki, modelled on the Yamaha YFZ450. Returning from past games, it is a single-seater and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Nagasaki Buzzard
vehicles.description: The civilian Nagasaki Buzzard light helicopter, now fitted with a side-mounted gun, seen in An Extended Look and the launch trailer.

vehicles.name: Nagasaki Carbon RS
vehicles.description: A motorbike from Nagasaki, modelled on the Ducati 1199. Returning from past games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Nagasaki Nimbe
vehicles.description: A scooter from Nagasaki, modelled on the Yamaha BWs 125. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Nagasaki Tao
vehicles.description: Nagasaki's Tao is a boat styled after the Crownline 275 SS. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Obey 8F Drafter
vehicles.description: The Obey 8F Drafter is a modern sports car with the look of the 2018 Audi RS5 Coupe. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Obey Animus
vehicles.description: The Obey Animus is a sedan with the look of the second-generation Audi A7. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Obey Omnis e-GT
vehicles.description: Obey's Omnis e-GT is a sports car styled after the Audi e-Tron GT. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Obey Tailgater
vehicles.description: A sedan from Obey, modelled on the Audi A6. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Obey Tailgater S
vehicles.description: Obey's Tailgater S is a sedan styled after the Audi RS3 Sedan. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Ocelot Jugular
vehicles.description: Ocelot's Jugular is a sports car styled after the Jaguar XE SV Project 8. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Ocelot Locust
vehicles.description: A sports car from Ocelot, modelled on the 2015 Lotus 3-Eleven. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Osprey Journey '78
vehicles.description: A 1970s van from Osprey, modelled on the 1979-1981 Fleetwood Pace Arrow. Returning from past games, it seats six and uses front-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Bati 801
vehicles.description: A motorbike from Pegassi, modelled on the Ducati 848. Returning from past games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Faggio
vehicles.description: A scooter from Pegassi, modelled on the Piaggio Vespa LX. Returning from past games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Infernus '96
vehicles.description: Pegassi's Infernus '96 is a 1990s classic sports car styled after the Lamborghini Diablo. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Police Tempesta
vehicles.description: The police version of the Pegassi Tempesta, a supercar built for law enforcement on Leonida's roads. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Speeder
vehicles.description: The Pegassi Speeder is a boat with the look of the Coeur 290 Nighthawk. A series regular, it carries four people.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Tempesta
vehicles.description: A supercar from Pegassi, modelled on the Lamborghini Huracán/Centenario. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Toros
vehicles.description: The Pegassi Toros is an SUV with the look of the Lamborghini Urus. A series regular, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pegassi Vitello
vehicles.description: The Pegassi Vitello is a supercar with the look of the Lamborghini Aventador SV. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Pfister Astron
vehicles.description: The Pfister Astron is a modern SUV with the look of the Porsche Macan. A series regular, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pfister Comet '88
vehicles.description: A 1980s sports car from Pfister, modelled on the Rauh-Welt Porsche 911 930. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio
vehicles.description: Pfister's Comet S2 Cabrio is a sports car with a soft top styled after the Porsche 911 Turbo S Cabriolet. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pfister Growler
vehicles.description: Pfister's Growler is a sports car styled after the Porsche 718 Cayman. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Pfister Neon
vehicles.description: An electric sports car from Pfister, modelled on the Porsche Taycan. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Piccia Furia
vehicles.description: Piccia's Furia is a supercar styled after the Ferrari 488 Pista. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Principe Alvino V1
vehicles.description: Principe's Alvino V1 is a motorbike styled after the Ducati Panigale V2 Sport Bike. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Principe Esskey
vehicles.description: A Principe motorbike that turns up in GTA 6, sitting alongside the maker's Lectro and Alvino V1. Its stats are still being worked out.

vehicles.name: Principe Lectro
vehicles.description: A motorbike from Principe, modelled on the Ducati Streetfighter S. Returning from past games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Progen Emerus
vehicles.description: Progen's Emerus is a supercar styled after the McLaren Senna. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: RON Car Wash
vehicles.description: RON Car Wash is a car wash in GTA 6. RON has 3 car washes next to its gas network.

vehicles.name: Rugger Rhode
vehicles.description: Rugger's Rhode is a boat styled after the Contender 39ST. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Rugger Rhode Police
vehicles.description: The police version of the Rugger Rhode, a boat used by Leonida law enforcement. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

vehicles.name: Scar Assault Rifle
vehicles.description: The Scar Assault Rifle is a GTA 6 assault rifle based on the FN SCAR-H/L, related to GTA Online's Heavy Rifle. Capacity, price and stats are not published yet.

vehicles.name: Schyster Deviant
vehicles.description: The Schyster Deviant is a muscle car with the look of the 1972 AMC Javelin. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Schyster PMP 700
vehicles.description: The Schyster PMP 700 is a sedan with the look of the second-generation Chrysler 300 (LD). First appearing in GTA 6, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Schyster Woodland '85
vehicles.description: A 1980s sedan from Schyster, modelled on the 1986-1988 Chrysler LeBaron Town & Country wagon. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Scorcher
vehicles.description: A bicycle from Del Perro, modelled on the Saracen Zen. Returning from past games, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Sea Sparrow
vehicles.description: The Sea Sparrow is a helicopter with the look of the Sikorsky S-300. A series regular, it carries two people.

vehicles.name: Seashark Hydroblast
vehicles.description: Seashark's Hydroblast is a boat styled after the Sea Doo RXT. Back from earlier GTA games, it carries two people.

vehicles.name: Seashark Sedna
vehicles.description: A boat from Seashark, modelled on the Sea-Doo RXT-X 300. It makes its series debut in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Shasa
vehicles.description: The Shasa is a boat with the look of the Sea Ray 350 Sundancer. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Shift-E Fan-E
vehicles.description: An e-scooter from Shift-E, modelled on the Bird One rental e-scooter. A newcomer in GTA 6, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Shitzu Squalo
vehicles.description: The Shitzu Squalo is a boat with the look of the Riviera M290 Sports Cruiser. A series regular, it carries two people.

vehicles.name: Shitzu Tropic
vehicles.description: A boat from Shitzu, modelled on the Sea Ray 300 Sundancer. Returning from past games, it carries four people.

vehicles.name: Sirius Sungrazer '61
vehicles.description: The Sirius Sungrazer '61 is a 1960s coupe with the look of the 1960-1961 Mercury Comet. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Sirius Transgressor '67
vehicles.description: A 1960s muscle car from Sirius, modelled on the 1970 Mercury Cougar. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Speedophile Seashark (2nd generation)
vehicles.description: A compact Speedophile personal watercraft in the style of a Sea-Doo Spark, first seen in Trailer 2. Its final in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Steal Vehicles for Moses
vehicles.description: Steal Vehicles for Moses is a Chapter 2 side mission with six vehicles to steal and deliver to Moses' shop in Port Gellhorn, paying $1,400 to $6,310 each.

vehicles.name: Swamp Blaster
vehicles.description: The Swamp Blaster is an off-roader with the look of the Florida swamp buggy. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

vehicles.name: Take Care of Jason
vehicles.description: Take Care of Jason is a Chapter 2 mission where Lucia checks on Jason at the Starlet Motel at the end of each day. It cannot be missed and completes after Breakfast Run.

vehicles.name: The Cartel Heist
vehicles.description: The Cartel Heist is the final Chapter 3 mission. Raul's crew robs Sinfrontera National Bank for $120,000, ending with a freeway escape.

vehicles.name: Truffade Thrax
vehicles.description: A supercar from Truffade, modelled on the Bugatti Divo. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Übermacht Apoc
vehicles.description: A reworked take on the Übermacht Apoc, built as a convertible. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Übermacht Cypher
vehicles.description: The Übermacht Cypher is a sports car with the look of the BMW M2 (F87). A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Übermacht FCR 1000
vehicles.description: The Übermacht FCR 1000 is a motorbike with the look of the BMW R100. A series regular, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Übermacht Rebla GTS
vehicles.description: An SUV from Übermacht, modelled on the fourth-generation BMW X5 (G05). Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Übermacht Sentinel '85
vehicles.description: Übermacht's Sentinel '85 is a 1980s classic sports car styled after the BMW E30 M3. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Ubermacht Sentinel Classic Cabrio
vehicles.description: The soft-top version of the Übermacht 1980s sports saloon, a convertible take on the E30-era shape seen in official GTA 6 footage.

vehicles.name: Übermacht Sentinel XS
vehicles.description: Übermacht's Sentinel XS is a coupe styled after the BMW M3 E92. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Übermacht Zion
vehicles.description: The Übermacht Apoc is a modern coupe with the look of the BMW M6 E63. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Airgator fanboat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Panther Airboat. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Audi Q7-style SUV
vehicles.description: An SUV modelled on the second-generation Audi Q7. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Azimut 85-style yacht
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Azimut 85. It makes its series debut in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Azimut Atlantis 45-style yacht
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Azimut Atlantis 45. It makes its series debut in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed baggage trailer
vehicles.description: A low airport baggage trailer, the kind pulled in trains behind a tug, seen in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Bavaria SR33-style boat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Bavaria SR33. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Brute excavator
vehicles.description: A Brute tracked excavator working on Leonida's building sites, seen in An Extended Look. It may be one of the looks of the B3000 Excavator.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Buckingham civilian helicopter
vehicles.description: A civilian Buckingham helicopter that shares its airframe with the police version, seen flying in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed car trailer
vehicles.description: A flat car transporter trailer in the style of an Ifor Williams CT177, seen hitched up in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed classic car

vehicles.name: Unnamed cruise ship
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Royal Caribbean Voyager-class cruise ship. It is new to the series in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed De Hoop Brion-style barge
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Shipyard De Hoop "Brion" roll-on/roll-off barge. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Del Perro electric bike
vehicles.description: A Del Perro electric mountain bike in the style of a Santa Cruz Vala, seen in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed dive boat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Crusader Boats GFY. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Dodge Dakota-style convertible pickup
vehicles.description: A pickup truck modelled on the 1989-1991 Dodge Dakota convertible. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Duke Arms carbine
vehicles.description: A shorter Duke Arms carbine with a different stock, fired at police by Raul in a clip on Rockstar's site. Its in-game name is not yet pinned down.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Eurocopter EC135-style police helicopter
vehicles.description: A police helicopter with the twin-engine lines of a Eurocopter EC135 and markings along its tail boom, shown in the Jason and Lucia 02 artwork.

vehicles.name: Unnamed ferry
vehicles.description: A boat. It makes its series debut in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed fishing boat

vehicles.name: Unnamed Ford F-Series-style medium-duty truck
vehicles.description: A commercial truck modelled on the seventh-generation Ford F-Series medium duty. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Ford F-Series-style pickup
vehicles.description: A pickup truck modelled on the third-generation Ford F-Series. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Ford F-Series-style tow truck
vehicles.description: A utility vehicle modelled on the sixth-generation Ford F-Series tow truck. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Frauscher 1017 GT-style boat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Frauscher 1017 GT. It is new to the series in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Freightliner M2-style truck
vehicles.description: A modern box truck with the cab of a Freightliner M2, seen making deliveries in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed International 4700-style truck
vehicles.description: A medium-duty work truck with the boxy lines of an International 4700, seen in official screenshots. Its in-game name is still unknown.

vehicles.name: Unnamed International S-1700-style truck
vehicles.description: A medium-duty truck seen as a tow truck in Trailer 1 and in other bodies in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed International S-Series-style semi truck
vehicles.description: A utility vehicle modelled on the International S-Series. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed jet ski trailer
vehicles.description: A small trailer built to carry a jet ski to the water, seen in Trailer 2 and the launch trailer.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Kellison J4-style sports car
vehicles.description: A classic sports car modelled on the Kellison J4 coupe kit cars of the 1950s. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Lürssen Coral Ocean-style superyacht
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Lürssen 73m Coral Ocean. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Maibatsu excavator
vehicles.description: A compact Maibatsu digger seen on a work site in the launch trailer. Its in-game name has not been confirmed.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Mercedes-Benz CLE-style convertible
vehicles.description: A coupe modelled on the Mercedes-Benz CLE Cabriolet (A236). A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Metrorail train
vehicles.description: A service vehicle modelled on the Hitachi Rail cars of the Miami-Dade Metrorail. It makes its series debut in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Nagasaki boat
vehicles.description: A Nagasaki jet boat with the look of a Yamaha 242 Limited, cruising Leonida's waters in Trailer 1 and Trailer 2.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Nagasaki Carbon RS stock motorcycle
vehicles.description: A plainer, factory-spec version of the Nagasaki Carbon RS sports bike, seen in Trailer 1 and An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed passenger stair trailer
vehicles.description: A mobile set of boarding stairs used at the airport to get passengers on and off planes, seen in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed RB-S II-style coast guard boat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Response Boat - Small II (RB-S II). GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed RB-S-style patrol boat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Defender-class Response Boat - Small (RB-S). It makes its series debut in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed SCAR-style assault rifle
vehicles.description: A modern battle rifle in the FN SCAR mould, glimpsed in the launch trailer. It is missing from the full post-launch weapon lists, so its in-game name is unknown.

vehicles.name: Unnamed self-propelled barge
vehicles.description: A cargo barge with a small cabin at the bow, carrying containers through the Leonida Keys in both main trailers.

vehicles.name: Unnamed shrimp boat
vehicles.description: A working shrimp trawler, seen passing under a road bridge in the Leonida Keys in Trailer 1 and on the Keys postcard.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Skater 388-style powerboat
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Skater 388. It makes its series debut in GTA 6. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Suzuki GSX-R1000-style sports bike
vehicles.description: A motorbike modelled on the 2017 Suzuki GSX-R1000. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed telehandler
vehicles.description: A yellow telescopic handler used on building and port sites, parked beside shipping containers in the launch trailer.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Tethered Aerostat Radar System-style aerostat
vehicles.description: A tethered radar balloon floating over the Leonida Keys, modelled on the real aerostat at Cudjoe Key and seen in both main trailers.

vehicles.name: Unnamed twin-axle boat trailer
vehicles.description: A longer two-axle boat trailer, seen hitched to a Vapid lifeguard pickup on Vice Beach in Trailer 1.

vehicles.name: Unnamed twinjet
vehicles.description: A twin-engine airliner in the style of a Boeing 767, shown coming in to land over Vice City on Rockstar's site and in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed utility trailer
vehicles.description: A small open utility trailer for hauling gear behind a car or pickup, seen in An Extended Look and official screenshots.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Vapid cargo van (E-Series style)
vehicles.description: A van modelled on the 2008-2014 Ford E-Series (Econoline). A newcomer in GTA 6, it carries ten people. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Unnamed VCIA airport train
vehicles.description: The automated people-mover that links terminals at Vice City International Airport, seen in An Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Unnamed Viewliner-style railroad car
vehicles.description: A long-distance passenger rail car in the style of an Amtrak Viewliner, seen in An Extended Look and on the official website.

vehicles.name: Unnamed water taxi
vehicles.description: A boat modelled on the Water Taxi Miami hop-on hop-off boats. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series. Its in-game name is not yet known.

vehicles.name: Vapid Aleutian
vehicles.description: The Vapid Aleutian is a modern SUV with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Expedition (U553). A series regular, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Caracara
vehicles.description: Vapid's Caracara is an off-roader styled after the Ford F-150. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats five and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Caracara 4x4
vehicles.description: An off-roader from Vapid, modelled on the 2nd gen Ford F-150 Raptor (P552). Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Dominator
vehicles.description: The Vapid Dominator is a muscle car with the look of the Ford Mustang. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Dominator '65
vehicles.description: Vapid's Dominator '65 is a 1960s muscle car styled after the Ford Mustang (1st Gen). New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Vapid Dominator ASP
vehicles.description: A muscle car from Vapid, modelled on the Ford Mustang SVT Cobra R (New Edge). Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Dominator GT
vehicles.description: The Vapid Dominator GT is a muscle car with the look of the 2018-2023 Ford Mustang Convertible. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Dominator GTX
vehicles.description: Vapid's Dominator GTX is a muscle car styled after the sixth-generation Ford Mustang. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Ganado
vehicles.description: A 1970s pickup truck from Vapid, modelled on the Ford Ranchero (5th generation). A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Vapid Ganado ’70
vehicles.description: The Vapid Ganado '70 is Jason's personal muscle truck in GTA 6, and the Ultimate Edition adds retro mods for it.

vehicles.name: Vapid Golfer
vehicles.description: Vapid's golf cart, a small modern utility runabout new to the series in GTA 6. It carries no tracker, so it is easy to take.

vehicles.name: Vapid Guardian
vehicles.description: A Vapid truck listed in GTA 6's industrial class. Its stats, price and where to find one have not been confirmed yet.

vehicles.name: Vapid Hustler '32
vehicles.description: A 1930s muscle car from Vapid, modelled on the 1932 Ford coupe. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Liberator
vehicles.description: The Vapid Liberator is an off-roader with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Super Duty. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Lowline
vehicles.description: Vapid's Lowline is a sedan styled after the 2013-2019 Ford Taurus. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Marshall
vehicles.description: A Vapid off-roader built on a heavy-duty pickup base in the style of a modern Ford Super Duty. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Vapid Minivan
vehicles.description: Vapid's Minivan is a van styled after the Ford Windstar. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Montagne
vehicles.description: Vapid's Montagne is an SUV styled after the fifth-generation Ford Explorer (2016 facelift). New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Montagne Pickup
vehicles.description: An off-roader from Vapid, modelled on the second-generation Ford Explorer Sport Trac. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Montagne Pickup (Lifeguard)
vehicles.description: The lifeguard version of the Vapid Montagne Pickup, used by beach lifeguards. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Montagne Police Unmarked
vehicles.description: An unmarked police version of the Vapid Montagne SUV, used by plain-clothes officers who would rather not be noticed on Leonida's roads.

vehicles.name: Vapid Montagne XL
vehicles.description: Vapid's Montagne XL is an SUV styled after the second-generation Ford Explorer. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Police Cruiser (Stanier LE)
vehicles.description: The police version of the Vapid Stanier G2, used by Leonida law enforcement. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Police Ghost (Stanier LE)
vehicles.description: The police version of the Vapid Stanier G2, used by Leonida law enforcement. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Police Lowline
vehicles.description: The police version of the Vapid Lowline, used by Leonida law enforcement. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Police Montagne
vehicles.description: The police version of the Vapid Montagne, used by Leonida law enforcement. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Reclaimer
vehicles.description: Vapid's Reclaimer is an off-roader styled after the 2019-2023 Ford Ranger (T6). New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Vapid Reclaimer '70s
vehicles.description: A 1970s-era Vapid off-roader that shares its name with the modern Reclaimer pickup. It is new in GTA 6 and has no tracker fitted.

vehicles.name: Vapid Riata Classic
vehicles.description: Vapid's Riata Classic is an SUV styled after the first-generation Ford Bronco. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Vapid Rumpo
vehicles.description: The Vapid Rumpo is a van with the look of the Ford E-Series. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Sadler
vehicles.description: The Vapid Sadler is a utility vehicle with the look of the first Generation Ford F250 Super Duty. A series regular, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Sandking XL
vehicles.description: An off-roader from Vapid, modelled on the Ford Super Duty. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Sandking XT
vehicles.description: The Vapid Sandking XT is an off-roader with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Super Duty (2020 F-450). First appearing in GTA 6, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Shifter
vehicles.description: A van from Vapid, modelled on the fourth-generation Ford Transit. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Vapid Shuttle
vehicles.description: The Vapid Shuttle is a van with the look of the fourth-generation Ford Transit. First appearing in GTA 6, it carries ten people.

vehicles.name: Vapid Slamvan '56
vehicles.description: A 1950s muscle car from Vapid, modelled on the Rat-rodded 1953-1956 Ford F-Series pickup. Returning from past games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Speedo
vehicles.description: The Vapid Speedo is a van with the look of the 2003-present Chevrolet Express van. A series regular, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Stanier '98
vehicles.description: A 1990s sedan from Vapid, modelled on the Ford Crown Victoria. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Stanier G2
vehicles.description: A late-1990s Vapid four-door in the Crown Victoria mould, seen often in pre-launch footage. It may be the same car that appears in the game as the Stanier '98.

vehicles.name: Vapid Stanier G2 (donk)
vehicles.description: The late-1990s Vapid Stanier sedan raised on huge wheels in classic donk style, first spotted in Trailer 1.

vehicles.name: Vapid Stanier Taxi
vehicles.description: The taxi version of the Vapid Stanier '98, working as a cab around Leonida. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vapid Tow Truck
vehicles.description: A utility vehicle, spotted in Trailer 1.

vehicles.name: Vice City Metro Mule
vehicles.description: The Vice City Metro Mule is a service vehicle with the look of the Innovia APM 100. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

vehicles.name: Vom Feuer Carbine Rifle
vehicles.description: The Vom Feuer Carbine Rifle is GTA 6's returning series-standard rifle based on the Remington R5 RGP and HK416. It holds 30 rounds (100 extended); price and stats are not published yet.

vehicles.name: Vulcar Ingot
vehicles.description: Vulcar's Ingot is a sedan styled after the VW Passat wagon. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats four and uses front-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Vysser Neo
vehicles.description: The Vysser Neo is a sports car with the look of the Spyker C8 Aileron. A series regular, it seats two and uses all-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Western Cliffhanger
vehicles.description: A stripped-down, flat-track inspired stunt motorcycle built for high-torque hill climbing and agile off-road trail riding.

vehicles.name: Western Company Duster
vehicles.description: A plane from Western Company, modelled on the Stearman Model 75. Returning from past games, it carries two people.

vehicles.name: Western Nightblade
vehicles.description: Western Motorcycle Company's Nightblade is a motorbike styled after the Harley-Davidson Night Rod Special. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Western Sovereign 107
vehicles.description: A motorbike from Western Motorcycle Company, modelled on the Harley Davidson Road King. Returning from past games, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Western Sovereign 107 Police
vehicles.description: The police version of the Western Sovereign 107, a motorbike built for law enforcement on Leonida's roads. Back from earlier GTA games, it has room for the rider only.

vehicles.name: Western Zombie Chopper
vehicles.description: Western Motorcycle Company's Zombie Chopper is a motorbike styled after the Harley Davidson Fat Bob Custom. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Willard Faction Custom Donk
vehicles.description: The Willard Faction Custom Donk is a muscle car with the look of the 1982-1987 Buick Regal. A series regular, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.

vehicles.name: Willard Grouse '92
vehicles.description: Willard's Grouse '92 is a 1990s sedan styled after the 1992-1995 Buick Skylark. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Willard Lasso '90
vehicles.description: The Willard Lasso '90 is a 1990s coupe with the look of the 1990-1991 Buick Reatta convertible. First appearing in GTA 6, it seats two.

vehicles.name: Willard Moocher '83
vehicles.description: Willard's Moocher '83 is a 1980s van styled after the 1985 Fleetwood Southwind. New to the series in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Willard Transient
vehicles.description: A sedan from Willard, modelled on the sixth-generation Buick Regal. A newcomer in GTA 6, it seats four.

vehicles.name: Willard Trotter '95
vehicles.description: The Willard Trotter '95 is a 1990s van with the look of the Rexhall RoseAir. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

vehicles.name: Xero Car Wash
vehicles.description: Xero Car Wash is a car wash in GTA 6. Xero runs 2 car washes.

vehicles.name: Yakuruna
vehicles.description: The Yakuruna is a boat with the look of the Riva 86 Domino. GTA 6 is its first appearance in the series.

vehicles.name: Zirconium Stratum
vehicles.description: A sedan from Zirconium, modelled on the Honda Accord station wagon. Returning from past games, it seats four and uses all-wheel drive.
